invariants.rationale: Method requires tile to operate on as first parameter; it is likely expected to be non-null.
Method expects tileElement to provide XML hierarchy and is dereferenced without null check.
If an objectgroup child exists, its name must be 'objectgroup'.
If objectgroup child exists, getChildrenByName should not throw and size is non-negative.
If the body of the loop runs, tile is needed and must be non-null.
